recorded: GET /mcp/info as tempo_gateway.mcp_server.describe answers it: the tools' own descriptions and annotations, read from mcp_server.py on 25 Oct 2026. The URL is a placeholder: a live Gateway answers with its public URL + /mcp.

tools.name: check_message
tools.description: Check a text, email or message the person is unsure about, with Tempo's Scam Shield. It looks at the words, the links and the sender. It never calls a message safe.

tools.name: read_letter
tools.description: Read a photographed letter: what it is, who sent it, any money owed either way, what must be done and by when. Anything Tempo is unsure of is listed. The photo isn't kept.

tools.name: start_rail_claim
tools.description: Start a Delay Repay claim for a late UK train. Tempo checks the rail records and the operator's rule and works out what is owed. Then the claim waits: the person approves it on their own device, and this tool never can. The same journey twice is one claim.

tools.name: start_missed_visit_claim
tools.description: Start a claim for a broadband or phone engineer who didn't come. Tempo plans when to act. Nothing is sent until the person approves on their own device; this tool never can. The same provider and day twice is one claim.

tools.name: claim_status
tools.description: Where a claim stands: its state, Tempo's latest message, the amount and the timeline.

tools.name: money_returned
tools.description: The Time Ledger: the money and the hours Tempo has won back, counted once paid.

tools.name: screen_entitlements
tools.description: A quick check of benefits and discounts worth a look, from ten answers. It is screening, not a decision; each flag links the official checker.

tools.name: verify_mandate
tools.description: For a company's agent: is this Agent Passport mandate genuine, live, issued by Tempo, and does it cover this action and amount? Fails closed.
